name: Goldpac Group Limited
summary: Goldpac Group Limited, founded in 1993 and based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong, is an investment holding company in mainland China and abroad. It supplies embedded software, secure payment products and smart self-service financial kiosks, reported in an embedded software and secure payment segment and a platform and service segment. It also offers smart cards, intelligent terminals, fintech services for banks, and data processing solutions for financial, retail, social security, healthcare and transportation clients.
